title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Standard and Basic licensed devices in the Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the summary says Microsoft has stated no consequence for unlicensed devices, but the cited licensing page explicitly describes loss of Pro Management capabilities. The licence-assignment path and Graph operation are documented; the summary must preserve the distinction between that published warning and the unresolved details of this change.

claims.claim: A room's licence is assigned in Microsoft 365 admin center under Users > Active users > room account > Licenses and apps.
claims.quote:
Go to Users > Active users, and select the room you created to open the properties panel. In the panel, select Licenses and apps.
Check the box next to Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro or Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic
claims.fix: Complete the control path as "Users > Active users > room account > Licenses and apps > Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro or Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic". The existing path reaches the correct page but stops before the licence checkbox; "room account" is a valid selection placeholder, not an invented label.
